ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: Adaptable and ambitious. Humans thrive through sheer determination and versatility, compensating for their lack of innate magic with an unmatched capacity to learn and grow.
ancestries.lore: The first settlers to bond with the Everwood, Humans arrived in Verdance generations ago and built the foundations of civilization amid the living forest. Their adaptability allowed them to navigate the complex politics of the Domain, forging alliances with the Emerald Coven and the Bloomguard alike. Most numerous in Verdance, they fill every role from soldier to scholar, their ambition tempered by the ever-present dangers of the Abyss. It is said that Humans were the first to petition the Veilkeepers for knowledge, establishing the consultation traditions that persist to this day.

attributeModifiers.description: +1 to any single attribute of the player's choosing at character creation

specialAbility.name: Adaptability
specialAbility.description: +10% XP gain from all sources. Humans learn faster than any other ancestry, turning every experience into accelerated growth.

bodyTypes.name: Lean
bodyTypes.description: A slim, agile frame suited for quick movement and finesse.

bodyTypes.name: Athletic
bodyTypes.description: A balanced, muscular build reflecting physical training and endurance.

bodyTypes.name: Heavy
bodyTypes.description: A broad, powerful frame built for strength and resilience.

magical.name: Crimson Ember
magical.unlockCondition: Survive a Crimson Sap phase at DSP below 30

ancestries.name: Soulborn
ancestries.description: Born from the Everwood's soul magic, Soulborn are rare beings with an innate connection to the Domain Soul Pool. They perceive the world through layers of spiritual resonance that others cannot fathom.
ancestries.lore: Soulborn are not born of flesh and blood in the traditional sense. During Silver Sap phases, when the Everwood's magical energies reach their peak, the forest itself occasionally gives rise to new life — beings woven from concentrated soul energy and living wood. These rare individuals emerge fully formed from the roots of ancient trees, carrying memories that belong to no one and everyone. The Emerald Coven considers them sacred, living proof that the Domain Soul Pool is more than mere energy — it is a consciousness. Soulborn hear the Veil whisper in quiet moments and can sense disturbances in the spiritual fabric of Verdance before anyone else. Their connection to the DSP grants them a personal reserve larger than any other ancestry, making them natural conduits for the domain's power.

attributeModifiers.description: +1 Charisma — their soul-touched presence draws others in
+1 Insight — they perceive the spiritual undercurrents of the world
+5 to maximum personal DSP reserve, reflecting their deeper connection to the Domain Soul Pool

specialAbility.name: Soulborn Attunement
specialAbility.description: A suite of innate spiritual abilities granted by the Soulborn's unique origin. Includes Veil Sense (detect Veil disturbances naturally) and Silver Sap Affinity (+1 to all rolls during Silver Sap phase).

abilities.name: Veil Sense
abilities.description: Can sense Veil disturbances naturally, detecting spiritual anomalies, hidden portals, and corruption sources within a moderate radius.

abilities.name: Silver Sap Affinity
abilities.description: +1 bonus to all d20 rolls during the Silver Sap phase, as the Soulborn resonates with the heightened magical energy.

bodyTypes.name: Lean
bodyTypes.description: A slim, willowy frame that seems to bend like young branches in a breeze.

bodyTypes.name: Athletic
bodyTypes.description: A balanced build with an otherworldly grace, as if shaped by careful intention.

bodyTypes.name: Heavy
bodyTypes.description: A sturdy, grounded frame reminiscent of ancient tree trunks, radiating quiet power.

magical.name: Everwood Emerald
magical.unlockCondition: Complete an Unbinding during Silver Sap

magical.name: Sap Prism
magical.unlockCondition: Experience all three Sap phases in one playthrough

ancestries.name: Half-Abyss
ancestries.description: Touched by the Abyss yet not consumed. Half-Abyss carry corruption in their veins but refuse to surrender to it, wielding their tainted heritage as both weapon and burden. Feared by many, understood by few.
ancestries.lore: The Half-Abyss are living paradoxes — offspring of Verdance dwellers who were exposed to concentrated Abyss energy, or in rarer cases, the children of unions between mortals and Abyss-touched beings. They carry corruption in their blood, but through sheer will or some unknown quirk of spiritual genetics, they resist the madness that claims most who touch the void. The Bloomguard watches them with suspicion, the Emerald Coven studies them with fascination, and the common folk avoid them with fear. Half-Abyss constantly struggle against the whispers of the Abyss that echo in their minds, but this very struggle grants them extraordinary resilience. Their existence is only revealed to the player after Act 1, when the true scope of the Abyss threat becomes clear and certain... previously impossible unions come to light.

attributeModifiers.description: +2 Resilience — their bodies are hardened by the constant internal battle against corruption
-1 Charisma — the visible signs of Abyss taint make social interactions more difficult

specialAbility.name: Abyssal Heritage
specialAbility.description: A suite of abilities born from the Half-Abyss's corrupted bloodline. Includes innate corruption resistance, immunity to the Corrupted status effect, and reduced criminality penalties when using Forbidden spells.

abilities.name: Corruption Resistance
abilities.description: 50% reduced effect from all corruption sources. The Abyss within recognizes and neutralizes external corruption.

abilities.name: Abyss Immunity
abilities.description: Completely immune to the Corrupted status effect. Cannot be turned by Abyss corruption.

abilities.name: Forbidden Affinity
abilities.description: Can use Forbidden spells with 10% reduced criminality penalty. The Abyss taint provides a natural affinity for dark magic.

unlockCondition.description: Complete Act 1 to unlock the Half-Abyss ancestry. The true nature of the Abyss threat must be revealed before this path becomes available.

bodyTypes.name: Lean
bodyTypes.description: A gaunt, sinewy frame with visible dark veins tracing beneath the skin.

bodyTypes.name: Athletic
bodyTypes.description: A hardened build marked by patches of void-darkened skin and subtle asymmetry.

bodyTypes.name: Heavy
bodyTypes.description: A massive, imposing frame with crystallized corruption formations along the shoulders and arms.

magical.name: Abyssal Flame
magical.unlockCondition: Defeat an Abyss boss without taking corruption damage

magical.name: Purified Crimson
magical.unlockCondition: Survive Crimson Sap with corruption resistance active

magical.name: Redeemed Gold
magical.unlockCondition: Achieve maximum reputation with the Emerald Coven as Half-Abyss

ancestries.name: Stonekin
ancestries.description: Living statues quickened by the Everwood's deep roots. Stonekin are slow to move and slow to anger, but nearly impossible to break. Their bodies are grown stone laced with living sapwood.
ancestries.lore: When the Everwood's roots wind around the buried megaliths of the old world, the stone sometimes wakes. Stonekin emerge from quarries and ruined foundations over decades, mineral bodies threaded with green sapwood that pulses like a slow heartbeat. They speak rarely and remember everything, serving the Bloomguard as immovable bulwarks and the Emerald Coven as patient archivists. Fire and decay trouble them little, but the Abyss's hollowing whispers can crack even stone given time. A Stonekin's word, once given, is said to outlast the mountains it was carved from.

attributeModifiers.description: +2 Resilience — a body of living stone shrugs off blows that would fell others
+1 Might — immense mineral mass behind every strike
-1 Agility — stone does not move quickly

specialAbility.name: Stone Endurance
specialAbility.description: Innate durability of a living statue: bonus starting Guard and resistance to physical and fire damage, offset by slower movement.

abilities.name: Living Bulwark
abilities.description: Start each combat with +3 Guard. Stonekin weather the opening blows of any fight.

abilities.name: Weathered Hide
abilities.description: 25% reduced physical and fire damage taken; -10% movement speed.

bodyTypes.name: Carved
bodyTypes.description: A narrow, chiseled frame like a temple pillar.

bodyTypes.name: Hewn
bodyTypes.description: A balanced megalithic build of fitted stone and sapwood.

bodyTypes.name: Monolithic
bodyTypes.description: A towering boulder of a body, grown over centuries.

magical.name: Sapglow Emerald
magical.unlockCondition: Reach Honored with the Emerald Coven

magical.name: Heartstone Gold
magical.unlockCondition: Survive a Crimson Sap phase without falling in combat

ancestries.name: Wispkin
ancestries.description: Veil-born fae of light and breath. Wispkin are quick, perceptive, and frail — flickers of the Veil given a mortal shape. They sense the unseen and dart where others lumber.
ancestries.lore: Where the Veil grows thin, motes of stray light sometimes refuse to fade. Given enough quiet years near a Veil-tear, they cohere into Wispkin: slight, luminous folk who seem half-here and half-elsewhere. They make peerless scouts and messengers, slipping through the Gloamwood where heavier folk would crash and blunder. The Veilkeepers favor them as students, for a Wispkin can hear the Veil's whisper without a Keeper's mediation. But their borrowed bodies are fragile, and a hard blow can scatter them like a snuffed candle — so they fight with wit, distance, and footwork rather than force.

attributeModifiers.description: +2 Agility — Wispkin move like blown light
+1 Insight — they perceive the Veil's currents directly
-1 Might — a body of light carries little force

specialAbility.name: Veil Flicker
specialAbility.description: Innate fae mobility and perception: improved evasion and movement, and reduced spell costs — at the price of a frailer body.

abilities.name: Fleetstep
abilities.description: +10% movement speed and improved evasion; Wispkin are hard to pin down.

abilities.name: Veil Attunement
abilities.description: Spells cost 2 less DSP (minimum 0). Wispkin draw on the Veil more efficiently than flesh-and-blood casters.

bodyTypes.name: Mote
bodyTypes.description: A barely-there wisp of a frame, light as breath.

bodyTypes.name: Flame
bodyTypes.description: A flickering, dancer's build with luminous edges.

bodyTypes.name: Lantern
bodyTypes.description: A fuller glow, brighter and a touch more grounded.
